scope.fixtureRule: No TypeScript source under app/(customer) or components/customer imports customer demo fixtures or labels persisted records as demonstrations.

controls: Every server page obtains a customer session or delegates its data fetch to an authenticated API.
Request and job list cursors are identity and filter scoped by the read repository.
Detail routes accept strict UUIDs and never fall back to mock records.
Review eligibility and duplicate review state are read from the owning session.
Warranty coverage uses the persisted job warranty date; claims come from the customer RLS projection.
The warranty form presents the customer's completed jobs instead of requiring a copied identifier.
No chat or live geolocation is advertised as available.
